body_markdown:
*Independent accountant’s interim review remains in process. The Company will provide a further update once the review is completed.*


DENVER--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


NUBURU, Inc. (NYSE American: BURU) today provided an update on its Quarterly Report on Form 10-Q for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, which the Company filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission on November 23, 2026.


At the time of filing, the Company’s independent registered public accounting firm had not completed its review of the interim financial statements included in that report. The review remains in process, including procedures relating to valuation and impairment matters.


The financial statements and related disclosures in the Form 10-Q are therefore subject to completion of that review and may change. As of the date of this release, the Company’s independent registered public accounting firm has not informed the Company of any required adjustment to the financial statements included in the Form 10-Q. Until the review is completed, investors should consider the financial information in the Form 10-Q in light of the status of the review.


NUBURU is working with its independent registered public accounting firm to complete the review as soon as possible. Once the review is completed, the Company will determine, together with its Audit Committee, securities counsel and independent registered public accounting firm, whether an amendment to the Form 10-Q or any other disclosure or filing is required.


The Company will provide a further update, including a discussion of its third-quarter results, once the review is completed.


**About NUBURU, Inc.**


NUBURU, Inc. (NYSE American: BURU) develops systems for defense and security, critical infrastructure and digital resilience. Its Defense & Security platform combines photonics, electronic warfare, special vehicles, operational-resilience software and advanced manufacturing.


**Forward-Looking Statements**


This release contains forward-looking statements within the meaning of the Private Securities Litigation Reform Act of 1995, Section 27A of the Securities Act of 1933 and Section 21E of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended. These statements include the completion, timing and outcome of the independent accountant’s interim review of the third-quarter financial statements, whether any amendment to the Form 10-Q or other disclosure or filing will be required, and the timing of future updates.


Actual results may differ materially. Risks include the possibility that completion of the interim review results in changes to the financial statements or disclosures in the Form 10-Q, delays in completing the review, the consequences of the Form 10-Q having been filed before the review was completed, NUBURU’s need for additional financing and the substantial doubt about its ability to continue as a going concern disclosed in its Form 10-Q. Other risks are described in NUBURU’s SEC filings. NUBURU undertakes no obligation to update forward-looking statements except as required by law.


The quarterly report and NUBURU’s other public filings are available on[SEC EDGAR](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.sec.gov%2Fedgar%2Fbrowse%2F%3FCIK%3D1814215%26owner%3Dexclude&esheet=54646013&newsitemid=20261124044742&lan=en-US&anchor=SEC+EDGAR&index=1&md5=8c2758b2cf39ddc5f47d742cc7edecbd) .
